_comment: Persistent registry of every base's real dest_bbox in the shared museum world, checked on every future placement to prevent overlap across separate tool runs. Fixes a real documented incident (see tools/apply_biome_placement.py's own header comment): find_biome_placement.lua's old 'claimed' overlap table only knew about bases passed into that ONE run, so a run against the full 203-entry master manifest silently overwrote Fort Alcazar's and cutecurly's City's already-planned positions. This file is the single source of truth for 'is this rectangle already spoken for', independent of which script or run placed it. Seeded 2026-09-20 (round 25 fitting-algorithm work) from museum-playtest/museum_manifest.json's 3 currently-deployed bases. Every future call to find_placement.lua must both check this file for overlap AND append its own result to it before finishing.

placements.note: first base placed via the new find_placement.lua/dest_eval_worldmod fitting pipeline, chosen from 10 evaluated candidates as lowest above-sea-level water count
